environment.description: Identical Node.js 18 container on ECS Fargate behind ALB. An AWS WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB containing a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 100 requests per 5-minute window per source IP, action: BLOCK) combined with a scope-down statement matching URI path '/graphql' and HTTP method POST. Additionally, a secondary rate-based rule with threshold 10 requests per 5-minute window is applied with a scope-down statement using a regex pattern matching the string 'batchUpdateSettings' OR '__proto__' OR 'constructor' in the request body (using a RegexPatternSet with body inspection enabled, first 8KB). Both rules return 429 before traffic reaches the application. The WAF is configured with CloudWatch metrics and sampled requests logging enabled.
